newsitem.title: UK: Strong sterling pushes LIFFE wheat lower.
newsitem.headline: Strong sterling pushes LIFFE wheat lower.

text.p: A strong pound sterling forced LIFFE wheat lower, traders said.
Active November last traded 0.55 stg lower at 94.75 stg. November volume was 345 of a total 860 lots.
"It was all on the basis of sterling," one trader said.

Sterling was off its peaks in late European trading, but stayed close to 2.79 marks, compared to under 2.77 late Tuesday, after a boost from bigger-than-expected fall in UK jobless and drop in U.S. PPI.
LIFFE barley also went lower. Only November traded, last changing hands at 91.50 stg, down 1.00 stg, on volume of 25 lots.
Physical market prices edged lower with brokers hinting at some farm selling.
"We think farmers are beginning to sell, but there are suggestions that some people are selling the market down in the hope of tempting the farmers out in a few days time," said one broker.
